Honkai: Star Rail to Release Version 4.7 Update on November 11
items.summary: HoYoverse announced on November 2 that Version 4.7, titled "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars," will be released for Honkai: Star Rail on November 11.
items.content:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on ⓒ HoYoverse HoYoverse announced on November 2 that Version 4.7, titled "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars," will be released for Honkai: Star Rail on November 11. This update introduces the limited 5-star character "Aeon★Aha" and the new character development system "EX-Eidolon," while the permanent content "Currency Wars" enters Season 2.

Joining as a playable character, "Aeon★Aha" is a character on the Path of Elation. They unlock new combat abilities for characters of the same Path within the party and accelerate the combat tempo of Elation skills during "Aha Time". When "Willpower," accumulated based on party members' actions, reaches a certain threshold, Aeon★Aha unleashes an Ultimate that deals Elation DMG to all enemies. Powered by the authority of an Aeon, ally attacks can also directly reduce enemies' max HP.

Character reruns will be split into the first and second halves of the version. The first half features limited 5-star characters "Silver Wolf LV.999," "Sparxie," and "Yao Guang," while the second half features "Acheron," "Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae," and "Jing Yuan". The "EX-Eidolon" system, which unlocks new additional skills for designated characters, will first apply combat buffs to "Acheron," "Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae," and "Jing Yuan".

In this story, the Trailblazer teams up with Aha, the Aeon of Elation, to face the ancient beast "Voracity". As "Voracity," which had been sealed in the "Illusion Moon Game" for thousands of Amber Eras, awakens, Aha executes the "Voracity Hunt" plan to stop the monster before its power fully recovers. To this end, Aha gathers eight petitioners and holds the "Final Illusion Moon Game" aboard the giant airship "Starfroster". This performance marks the final show that will decide the fate of "Planarcadia".

The permanent content "Currency Wars" will be reorganized for Season 2, "Bizarre Voyage in the Painting". Version events include "The Fluffy Express Movie: Bustling Kitchen," where players run a dessert shop with Aha, and the combat event "Starpeace Festival: Path of the Star". In "Fantasy Showtime," players can earn rewards such as the limited outfit "Starry Lottery" for Aeon★Aha.

On the update day of November 11, the short animated film "A Cheerful Funeral Under the Moonlight" will be released. The new song "Creation from Nothingness," which brings the story of "Planarcadia" to a grand conclusion, will also be unveiled.

Honkai: Star Rail will also participate in G-STAR 2026, which will be held from November 19 to 22 at BEXCO in Busan. A variety of stage programs will be hosted on-site.

items.title: Manage a Dessert Shop with an Actual God in Honkai: Star Rail's Climactic PS5 Update
items.content:
If you’re a regular of HoYoverse’s turn-based RPG Honkai: Star Rail , then you’ll probably have been waiting for 5-Star character Aha’s arrival, as part of v4.7 on 11th November.

The anticipated Aeon is effectively a god, bringing outrageous buffs to all characters on the path of Elation. She’s going to be essential if you’ve been pulling for any of the characters featured in the Planarcadia arc, like Sparxie and Silver Wolf Lv 999.

Her introduction to the gacha pool will coincide with a climactic conclusion to the current storyline.

I must admit, I’m a little relieved to hear that because while I’ve undoubtedly enjoyed the vibes of this new planet, the dev’s lore-heavy writing is losing me a lot lately. I personally find it difficult to keep up with the constant proper nouns.

Other activities in this update include a dessert shop management minigame that looks like a ton of fun, as well as new rules and content for the auto-chess inspired endgame mode, Currency Wars.

As mentioned, all of this new content will debut on 11th November, which is the same day as NTE’s new update goes live . That’s a lot of gacha game to get through before GTA 6 .

It's the End of an Era for PlayStation's Hit Space Opera on November 11
items.summary: It's the end of an era for PlayStation's hit anime space opera Honkai: Star Rail as its final Planarcadia update introduces a playable 5-star Aeon.
items.content:
The PlayStation Network logo Image via Sony Add CBR on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By Leo Reyna Published Oct 31, 2026, 6:00 PM EDT Leo Reyna is an entertainment journalist and editor with extensive experience covering anime, manga, and gaming. Before joining CBR, he contributed to major entertainment outlets including Static Media and Ranker, where he developed a reputation for insightful industry coverage and a deep understanding of fan culture.

At CBR, Leo reports on key developments within the anime industry—examining topics such as production challenges, studio practices, and creative communities—while also spotlighting the passion and artistry of fandoms worldwide.

Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Nearly a year after its debut, the "Planarcadia" saga of Honkai: Star Rail is coming to a close, but not without one final bang. The hit PlayStation anime space opera is bringing its latest major storyline to a bombastic conclusion this November, with Aeon ★ Aha making THEIR debut as a playable 5-star character.

HoYoverse, the global gaming publisher behind Genshin Impact and Zenless Zone Zero , has shared new details about the Nov. 11, 2026, update for Honkai: Star Rail on PlayStation 5 and other supported platforms. Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7, "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars," concludes the game's latest major storyline, which began in February. Aeon ★ Aha, also known as Nihilux, finally joins the game's ever-growing roster of playable characters as a 5-star Path of Elation character. More story and gameplay details below.

Honkai: Star Rail Version 4.7 will launch on Nov. 11. The fate of the universe hangs in the balance in the final chapter of the Planarcadia storyline, as Aeon ★ Aha officially makes THEIR debut. "Not only are THEY the director of this universe-wide performance, but THEY will also join the fray to initiate the final 'Phantasmoon Games,'" HoYoverse explains.

"In this update, the limited 5-star character on the Path of Elation, Aeon ★ Aha, will officially make THEIR debut," the official description reads. "As the creator of the 'Phantasmoon Games,' THEY have spent millennia observing the joys and sorrows of the cosmos through theatrics and jests. This time, to stop the Voracity from devouring the universe, Aha has decided to take the stage THEMSELF, orchestrating the grand finale of hunting the Voracity."
